aiResearchSummary.text: Spero Foods is engaged in developing processes and compositions for plant-based curd products, as described in 'Compositions of and methods for forming plant-based curd products.' The abstract details methods for producing curd by curdling materials containing at least 10% whole oilseed by dry weight, aligning with Spero’s focus on plant-based dairy alternatives. This research and development centers on innovative plant-based curd production and formulation.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
